name: RB-L14: Upcoming card count matches the Home Upcoming Booking stat
description: Read the Home Upcoming Booking stat value, open See all, count Upcoming cards. A readable stat that disagrees with the list card count is a data-consistency defect (cross-checked against the list API in RB-A3). When the stat value cannot be read from the tree, the mismatch is recorded as an observation.
